Definition: a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse
BiblicalUsage: 1) a lying down, couch, bier, act of lying; 1a) couch, bed; 1b) act of lying, lying down or sleeping room, bedroom; 1c) lying down (for sexual contact)
